cancellationInvestigation.finding: Native RPC HTTP waits for the first encoded response chunk. Two enable_request_signal fixture experiments failed with one-second timeouts and are retained as inconclusive full-case attempts. A separate direct-socket native Worker probe observed client abort without an incoming signal event during 1500 ms of pre-response work. Neither experiment qualifies a correction or establishes general production signal behaviour.
cancellationInvestigation.rollback: Restore the only experimental tracked test from base HEAD; confirmed exact original before the retained suite. Retain the private failed logs.
cancellationInvestigation.resumeTrigger: A supported native adapter or platform change can expose and qualify prompt pre-response cancellation without handwritten protocol or unapproved dependency changes.
cancellationInvestigation.nextOwner: Future supported native adapter/platform qualification; the accepted five-second bound remains the current contract

limitations: Modern outgoing TCP abort stops its caller; server work may continue until the five-second budget. Older or in-process cancellation does not prove prompt modern cleanup.
